core_claim: The asterisk that prefixes 33% of animal names in the Long Beach shelter dataset is a quiet code for human attachment, and reading the data through that code reveals a 2024 record-adoption year sitting on top of a flat live-release rate that the headlines never mention.
title: The Asterisk in the Animal Name
subtitle: 29,787 intakes, eight years, and the column the data dictionary buries in a footnote.

edt_01.label: Hook — three categories of animal
edt_01.title: Three categories of animal
edt_01.editorial_notes: The 41.3% vs 0.8% return-to-owner gap is the headline number for the whole piece. Do not round.

edt_02.label: A shelter, not just a cat-and-dog place
edt_02.title: A shelter, not just a cat-and-dog place
edt_02.editorial_notes: Use the long-tail species (rabbit, reptile, livestock, amphibian) to set up the variety chart. Open-admission framing comes from det_08.

edt_03.label: The pandemic V
edt_03.title: The pandemic V
edt_03.editorial_notes: Quarterly chart shows the shape better than the annual one — keep both numbers in prose.

edt_04.label: Kitten season is real
edt_04.title: Kitten season is real
edt_04.editorial_notes: May 901 vs December 82 is the centerpiece comparison — keep both numbers visible.

edt_05.label: The record year, the flat save rate
edt_05.title: 2024 was the best year. The save rate says it was just average.
edt_05.editorial_notes: The 92.2% (2020) vs 84.6% (2024) gap, and the 90% no-kill benchmark line, must all appear in the same chart. Use ana_caveat_06 — coincides with, not because of — when invoking Compassion Saves.

edt_06.label: Outcome depends on what you are
edt_06.title: What you are decides where you go
edt_06.editorial_notes: Pair the wild-animal 32.4% save rate with the explanation that those animals usually arrive non-survivable; otherwise the number reads as judgement.

edt_07.label: Triage at the door decides almost everything
edt_07.title: Triage at the door
edt_07.editorial_notes: 95.3% (normal) vs 24.9% (ill severe) gap is the spine of this section. Sort the chart by save_pct.

edt_08.label: Why people surrender, and length of stay
edt_08.title: Why people give up pets
edt_08.editorial_notes: Quietly include the housing/cost = ~50% framing. 'New baby' as 13 — smallest category — is the surprise.

edt_09.label: Where the animals come from
edt_09.title: Where the animals come from
edt_09.editorial_notes: Acknowledge the 560-intakes-at-the-shelter-address artefact when the map appears.

edt_10.label: Names they came in with
edt_10.title: Names they came in with
edt_10.editorial_notes: This section returns the asterisk theme to focus before the close. Top names provide warmth; ana_12 returns to mechanism.

edt_11.label: Close — the map and the asterisk
edt_11.title: The map and the asterisk
edt_11.editorial_notes: Close on tension, not on summary. The two numbers in the closing paragraph (more saved than ever; same percentage as last year) must both be true and both be present.
